notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation; the revised one draws the slip fits on the screws, all-threads and Nut Holders and the press fit on the motors' pilots in the top plates. The plan profiles are gated separately in render.rs --verify, and the dimensions and fits are in 520-001_ExGearMount.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
